title: Make preview generation scheduler latest-only and cancellable
description: Replace one uncancelled Task.Run per request with an explicit latest-request execution policy. Preserve newest-result-wins semantics while preventing stale requests from consuming full CPU and native-memory budgets when newer edits supersede them. Establish request-owned diagnostics so one GenerationDiagnostics instance cannot be concurrently mutated by multiple workers. Keep EnqueueCaptured as a narrow ownership-transfer seam or replace it with a safer internal/editor-specific capture API; do not make the detached-definition contract depend on convention alone.

comments.author: ChatGPT
comments.body: Current-head audit 2026-09-12: CreatureGenerationScheduler starts one uncancelled Task.Run per request and suppresses stale results only after work completes. EnqueueCaptured is also public and relies on caller-established detached-definition ownership. GenerationDiagnostics is mutable and can be externally supplied, so sharing one instance across concurrent requests would race its Lists. This is a concrete responsiveness/CPU/memory and API-contract problem; redesign is preferred over a tactical patch.
